limits.providerRankCoverage: Use source rank as supplied; provider-unranked players fall back to model category rank.
limits.rankOnlyFallback: No projected or modeled statistics are copied into the provider-first ranking artifact.
limits.sensitivity: Declared deterministic stress cases; not probabilities, confidence intervals, validation, or edge claims.
limits.positionProxies: G/F-C ranked-player cutoffs; dual-eligible players may occur in both groups and this is not a joint allocation.
